findings.title: The total can go below zero
findings.problem: A discount larger than the price makes the total negative.
findings.whyItMatters: A negative total means paying the customer.
findings.fixedLooksLike: A total never goes below zero.

findings.title: A missing or broken settings file gives an unhelpful error
findings.problem: A missing or broken settings file stops the program with a technical error.
findings.whyItMatters: Whoever runs it cannot tell which file to fix.
findings.fixedLooksLike: A missing or broken settings file gives a message naming the file.
